problem_type: Headless reference projection classifies request-body keys by name instead of declared media-carrying capability
symptom: A headless request carrying an image, video, or audio reference can put its URL into a boolean switch, enum, quantity, size, numeric, or voice field; a mapping with no declared same-media reference slot can still be sent.
direct_cause: referenceReachability and taskParams used REFERENCE_KEY_FAMILY and CONTROL_KEY_PREFIX regular expressions over bodyReferencedParamKeys, and projectReferencesOntoBodyKeys trusted that result.
class_root: The shared body-key boundary has no required declaration tying a request key to a reference media family, so every new vendor key whose spelling resembles image/video/audio remains eligible for silent projection.
affected_population: Headless and MCP callers that provide referenceImages, referenceVideoUrls, or referenceAudioUrls without an explicit body parameter name
All built-in catalog mappings whose creation body contains a key that resembles a reference but is actually a control
Custom relay mappings whose non-standard reference key has no shared declaration
entry_points: projectReferencesOntoBodyKeys projects headless references before task-template rendering
classifyReferenceKey and carried-reference readers classify input values for refusal labels
bodyReferenceSupport derives model-listing and reachable-mode reference capability

external_sources.purpose: OpenAPI makes URI semantics an explicit field format rather than a name-based inference.
OpenAPI describes parameter schemas and media-type serialization as the source for generated callers.
JSON Schema uses contentMediaType/contentEncoding annotations to declare the media carried by a value.
Generated SDK operations use concrete input shapes, so callers fill declared fields instead of guessing arbitrary file-like names.

invariants: A headless reference is projected only to a body key declared for the same media family.
A body key with an existing value, including false, is never overwritten by a projected URL.
If a carried media family has no declared body key, the request fails before network submission with an explicit parameter-name instruction.
Model listing and refusal suggestions use the same declaration-driven classification as projection.

door_reduction.why_not: The deleted regex classifier door is replaced by the declaration read doors. The six surviving doors are separate public consumers: model listing, declaration reads from referenceReachability and taskParams, projection, carried-reference classification, and refusal checks; they now all read the same declaration table and must keep their existing call contracts.

generality_proof: The body-key classifier is the shared boundary for projection, refusal labeling, refusal suggestions, and model listings. It reads the same declaration table assembled from typed slots, combined slots, explicit headless keys, translated inputs, and alias groups. Therefore a new provider key is either declared once with a media family and handled consistently by every caller, or it is not eligible and the carried family fails closed; no spelling-based vendor exception remains.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the explicit media-family and multi-value declaration for every reference input source and derive GENERIC_REFERENCE_KEYS from it.
Read the declaration table and return the declared family / shape, or null for every undeclared body key.
Project only same-family references into declared, body-referenced, empty keys and refuse when no same-family key exists.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The red census tests reproduce image, video, and audio URLs landing in control fields; projectReferencesOntoBodyKeys now consumes the declaration table directly.
list_models calls bodyReferenceSupport for every enabled mapping; its output will use the same declaration-driven classifier, removing false capability claims.
Refusal labels and suggestions call classifyReferenceKey / bodyReferenceSupport and therefore converge on the same declaration boundary.
This path already consumes the shared alias declaration and is not a name-regex classifier; its alias groups remain the source used to build the new declaration table.

recurrence.reason: The same body-key spelling heuristic can misclassify another provider, version, custom mapping, or newly added control field; the prior census already found 12 false-positive keys across 26 real catalog rows.
same_class_scan: scripts/reference-key-census.ts scans all 246 seeded mappings and records false positives independently from the projection output.
electron/catalog/referenceKeyProjectionCensus.test.ts covers real image, video, and audio headless inputs plus a body with its declared video key removed.

node scripts/door-map.mjs classifyReferenceKey bodyReferenceSupport projectReferencesOntoBodyKeys enumerates four surviving production consumer doors; the removed regex classifier is recorded in legacy_paths.
referenceSentWithinInUse.property.test.ts checks that every body reference key is present in the shared declaration set.

prevention.invariant: Only keys present in the explicit declaration table, with a matching media family, are reference carriers.
prevention.failure_mode: Undeclared keys are classified as null; projection leaves them untouched and a carried family with no declared same-family key is rejected before network submission with an explicit parameter-name instruction.
prevention.strategy: Delete the regex classifier and derive declarations from typed slots, explicit headless media declarations, translated inputs, combined slots, and alias groups. Every consumer reads the classifier; completeness tests make new body reference keys fail until they are declared.

legacy_paths.rationale: The obsolete regex classifier symbols REFERENCE_KEY_FAMILY, CONTROL_KEY_PREFIX, and classifyReferenceKeyDetailed are deleted from this file in the same change; no compatibility fallback remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is owned by Nomi's catalog declarations and pure TypeScript functions; no third-party runtime controls the classification boundary.

migration: No persisted data migration is required. Existing explicit reference keys and renderer archetypeInput values remain valid; headless callers whose non-standard key was previously guessed must now provide that key explicitly or add a declaration before sending.
residual_risks: Custom mappings whose body reference key is not in the declaration table will be rejected until the caller supplies an explicit parameter name; the repository cannot prove arbitrary user-authored contracts from seeded fixtures.
No real paid sample is run on this branch; the coordinator must execute the one-sample plan after free rehearsal and build-marker checks.
Windows and English UI paths are not exercised on this Mac-only implementation line.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 请求体参考键的分类是投影、拒发建议和目录承载力共同消费的最早共享边界；这些类级测试在该边界验证声明与 body 的对账。
